title: crotalaria albida var. epunctata
intro: Crotalaria albida var. epunctata, commonly known as White Rattlebox, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and gastrointestinal issues. The plant is reported to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents including alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins. Furthermore, the bioactive constituents in Crotalaria albida var. epunctata may also have potential in the development of new medicines due to their diverse pharmacological activities.
